ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 40% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels and 60% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central peduncle base and the entirety of the fluke perimeter consist of low-intensity black pixels. The interior of both lobes features large, contiguous high-intensity white zones interspersed with low-intensity vertical streaks and irregular dark mottling concentrated near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression with an approximate angle of 120 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) are visible along the distal two-thirds of the trailing edge on both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a generally convex mathematical curve that tapers into distinct, pointed tips at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered low-intensity circular pixel clusters are visible within the high-intensity white regions, particularly on the inner section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, dark, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible traversing the white pigmentation on both lobes.
